titulo: Why Shein's IPO valuation shrunk so dramatically | About That
cuerpo: Fast-fashion giant Shein is set to go public on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange at a fraction of its former $100-billion US valuation. Avneet Dhillon breaks down why one of the world's most successful fashion retailers is now struggling ahead of its IPO. (Photo credits: The Canadian Press, Reuters, Adobe Stock and Getty Images)
